_comment: Example Windows build-host table for the maintainer offload tooling (which is not in the public source tree). Copy to config/build-hosts.local.json (ignored) and fill in your own hosts, or point EAWR_BUILD_HOSTS at a table. Contributors build locally (docs/build.md) and need none of this.

windows.name: GPU-HOST-1
windows.note: Optional spare CPU slot on the example GPU host; enable only after measuring memory and queue benefit. Original-game and capture jobs exclude builds through the existing shared lease.
